annotations.text:
Regional prompts, redesigned.
BOTH SIDES: Common / Background / Style / custom fields marked Both, plus the shared Negative - written into both sides.
LEFT and RIGHT are stacked sections, not side-by-side columns: every row keeps the full 236px list width, so long names get ellipsis + tooltip instead of a 100px squeeze.
Each side shows its character (from the Characters card, read-only), its Positive, its own Negative and its side-only custom fields.

Swap sits between the shared block and the two sides: one click flips prompts, negatives, characters and Left/Right strengths, and the UI shows the swapped state. It replaces the 'Swap Character' checkbox.
Each side collapses from its header (RIGHT is shown collapsed): the character row stays visible and the header carries the field / tag count.
The character row is a button - it opens the same selection modal as the Characters card, so the character can be changed right here.
The editor badge ('LEFT · Hatsune Miku (Vocaloid)') is capped at 200px with ellipsis; 'Send to right' moves the selected capsules across.

Custom fields get a side: Both / Left / Right - on the negative chain too.
Built-ins keep their fixed side (Common, Background, Style = both; Positive and Negative = a shared field plus a left and a right field).
ComfyUI gets per-side negative conditioning (masked like the positives); Forge Neo folds per-side negatives into the shared one.
